classifiedDifferences.detail: Foundry stores Druidic Warrior as a separate auxiliary feature; Oracle models it as the alternative option inside Fighting Style.
Foundry represents Deft Explorer and Expertise choices additionally through Trait advancements; Oracle stores the same choices inside structured proficiency grants.
Foundry exposes Hunter's Mark Damage as a ScaleValue; Oracle keeps the baseline on Hunter's Mark/Favored Enemy and applies the d10 capstone through Foe Slayer.
